source: Existing explicitly user-authorized readonly audit agent; no heavy build/run performed

cpu.adapter: Keep isolated original DLL/ABI comparator. K/V independent Q8 row bytes, gather history as declared, output Dv, original F16 bottom-right inclusive window mask or no mask for full noncausal; original Q vec-dot conversion and V row dequant charged.

cuda.route: Independent raw FlashInfer Params/PrefillPlan and original mixed FP8 dispatch
cuda.adapter: Actual FP8 bytes/paged/ragged and independent K/V strides; sK in sm_scale, F32 output/split merge and final sV conversion must be included. No candidate provider entry as independent peer.
cuda.limitation: Original pinned 69ff 64/128 short-K kernel is known incorrect and cannot qualify. Shared repaired kernel would only qualify wrapper overhead, not independent algorithm performance for that shape.

finite_pipeline_peer_decision.route: Same immutable FP8 bytes -> cold checked GPU decode into extra readonly T16 snapshot -> pristine original69ff Params<T,T,T>/16-bit split merge
finite_pipeline_peer_decision.fairness: Prefer cold snapshot, matching the already accepted CPU cold alternate-cache contract. Repeating unchanged full-history decode in warm operations would be an unnecessary peer downgrade.
finite_pipeline_peer_decision.identity: Retain original FP8 exact-frame owners. Each episode verifies full original buffer/offset/extent/layout/scales/tails/pages identity; different payload/version requires rejection in this immutable scope.
finite_pipeline_peer_decision.cost: Measure/report cold initialization/checked completion/destruction and actual expanded capacity bytes. Two slots may share the same readonly snapshot; warm native plan/execution/normal completion/output costs stay charged.
finite_pipeline_peer_decision.precision: Decode K*sK and V*sV once into query same F16/BF16; sm_scale remains original attention scale. Only source-qualified finite dyadic .5/2 scale domain until actual independent oracle.
finite_pipeline_peer_decision.independence: Only pristine original69ff templates in a distinct peer namespace or independent DSO. No product short-K patch, candidate provider lowering, or candidate F32 merge specialization.
limits: No original correct direct-FP8 peer for all three shapes established
Resident-warm throughput vs extra-memory comparison, not direct-compressed or dirty/growth/capture/token-s qualification

apple.route: Original independent GGML Metal Q8 pipeline, not original MLX fast SDPA (has no Q8 ports)
apple.adapter: Account required Q conversion to F32, same compressed bytes/gather, original F16 mask for finite windows, output conversion and native completion. Q>=32 original host may expand complete KV to F16: valid same-Q8-input pipeline comparator only when ALL expansion dispatch/scratch/sync are counted, never a direct-compressed kernel claim.
apple.direct_compressed_peer: Existing original general Q8 kernels64/64,128/128,256/256 can be explicitly selected in benchmark without changing shader arithmetic; host dispatch adaptation must be disclosed.
apple.rectangular_64_128: Original general template separates DK/DV and has no observed DK>=DV constraint; original exports lack Q8 64/128. Bypassing vec selection alone does not create pipeline. Benchmark-only explicit instantiation may be feasible, but requires real compiler/oracle/cost qualification and is not an already-qualified peer.

resource_and_completion_audit.completion: ggml_backend_graph_compute returns the pre-synchronize async status; Metal synchronize records late CommandBuffer failure only in private has_error. That return alone is insufficient evidence of checked completion for this operation.
resource_and_completion_audit.mapping: Original host-pointer import rounds down/up to OS page boundaries and creates another no-copy MTLBuffer. Exact HYLE page leases alone do not authorize that enlarged mapping.
resource_and_completion_audit.bounded_adapter: Prefer the original private encoder bridge with the actual ready MTLBuffer plus offset and retained owner/range/device proofs, then inspect this operation's real CommandBuffer completion status. Keep original general-Q8 padding/mask/split/reduce and charge all conversion/gather/prepare/wait costs.
resource_and_completion_audit.rectangular_export: Dqk64/Dv128 needs an explicit benchmark-only original-template instance and real compiler/oracle qualification. No shader arithmetic changes or presumed numeric/P1 PASS.
resource_and_completion_audit.scope: These are independent peer adapter qualification constraints, not evidence of a newly missing HYLE product mechanism. Explicit general-kernel selection must be disclosed; no best-of original-host claim.

vulkan.route: Original independent non-MMQ scalar Q8 shader supports HSK/HSV and direct block34 decode
vulkan.adapter: Existing non-MMQ F32 shader supports Q8 specialization. Extend reference.cc K/V descriptions and strides independently, output Dv, Q8_0 type/blockbytes34 plus original F16 mask. Use matching non-MMQ tuning and split/reduce, not MMQ dispatch parameters.
vulkan.limitation: Original host may choose MMQ or full-history F16 expansion at Q>=64; disclose and fully count if benchmarking original whole pipeline.

preflight_requirements: Same encoded bytes, query/effective KV, scales, finite window, output type and accepted precision must first pass independent oracle.
Plan/gather/mask/convert/scratch/wait/retirement costs declared; pre-gathered immutable history is not an incremental-producer performance certificate.
5% margin, A/A and both execution/allocation orders use existing instruments after immutable candidate; no new P1 PASS from source reading.

cpu_preconstruction.candidate: BatchProgram/BatchInvocation -> original CPU queue -> changed paged Q8 native math, one thread, two slots, ready exact page owners.
cpu_preconstruction.peer: Same outer admission/result lifecycle; benchmark-only provider builds contiguous Q8 original ggml graph, independent pristine DLL compute/plan/pool, no candidate supports/lower/math.
cpu_preconstruction.arithmetic: BF16 Q -> F32 -> original Q8 vector-dot conversion on both; Q8 K/V same encoded bytes, Dqk/Dv independent, F32 accumulator and BF16 output; bottom-right inclusive finite window or full noncausal.
cpu_preconstruction.history: Original ready snapshot immutable throughout. Peer cold gathers referenced valid Q8 bytes into owned contiguous cache; bytes/storage reported, no warm history copies. This does not qualify incremental producers or G06 changing-layout planning.

completion.phase: input mappings and exact frame permissions

cpu_preconstruction.cold: Separately reported create/prepare/page/cache/mask/workspace/thread-pool setup and destruction; resident-warm claim only. No timing excludes material work belonging to one warm operation.
cpu_preconstruction.cancel_error: Ready immutable successful numerical comparison, no per-op cancellation or asynchronous peer work. Existing finite error/retirement qualification remains separate; adapter propagates original runtime status.
cpu_preconstruction.known_static_difference: Candidate boxed Q8 path computes bounds and has no Q*KV mask; original peer requires cold F16 mask for causal/window, skips masked values before dot/decode. Mask capacity and preparation cost explicit; no same-contract claim of equal storage.
normal_and_holdout: Q17/1 KV7/47 D64/128 full noncausal Q>KV
cpu_preconstruction.bound: Independent double oracle abs8e-3 plus direct arm disagreement <=8e-3; exact readonly encoded bytes after execution. Canonical zero scale inputs never rely on original undefined reciprocal encoding.
cpu_preconstruction.verdict: ADAPTER_CONSTRUCTION_ALLOWED; actual compilation/oracle pending; no performance sampling allowed before candidate.

checked: original DLL math/plan/pool and actual image ABI
independent K/V Q8 strides, offsets and Dv output
inclusive bottom-right window and full noncausal Q>KV
actual encoded-byte double oracle and readonly checks
charged update/run/wait/output lease return and release
reported cold gather/cache/mask bytes; no dirty producer claim
cpu_adapter_review.limits: No sampling or P1 verdict from readonly review
